items.title: Jack Lesberg interviewed by Monk Rowe, Aspen, Colorado, October 11, 1997
items.q: one of the first guys I came across, and he was about my age or a little bit younger, was Ray Brown.

ctx.x: Did you have influences on the bass? People that you emulated?

Well one of the first guys I came across, and he was about my age or a little bit younger, was Ray Brown. Because when I left Condon’s, the bit was at Condon’s there that they finally let the bass go down there to save some money, to save the salary. Because everybody that came in there sat in on the bass. So they figured they could get the bass for free. So I always used to say they cut the strings at Eddie Condon’s. That was my line. I forgot what I was trying to say—
